stated_count.quote: must print `CONFORMANCE RESULT PASS 13/13`. The thirteen named checks:

checks.title: shape
checks.quote: **shape** - count matches input, each embedding has 384 floats, all finite.

checks.title: non-degenerate
checks.quote: **non-degenerate** - three different texts, pairwise cosine < 0.99 (fails the zero-vector stub).

checks.title: batch-order-invariant
checks.quote: **batch-order-invariant** - batched result equals the single-input result, cosine >= 0.9999.

checks.title: long-input
checks.quote: **long-input** - an input of at least 1,609 wordpieces returns 200.

checks.title: reference-vectors
checks.quote: **reference-vectors** - every boundary text within cosine 0.9999 of the delivered reference vector.

checks.title: empty-string-400
checks.quote: **empty-string-400** - an empty-string input returns 400 with the OpenAI error envelope.

fields.texts: array of {id: string (required), text: string (optional, compared when present), vector: array of exactly 384 numbers (required)}

platform_event.quote: Who builds it: graph-rag's own tool

function_name.quote: graph-rag invokes only `lambda://<function-name>/v1/embeddings` where `<function-name>` starts with `aprender-embed-`
function_name.consistency: default starts with required_prefix; no conflict, so no owner decision branch applies

empty_input.quote: Empty string: refuse with 400 and the OpenAI error envelope

integer_inputs.value: out of scope; never sent; a 400 is fine
integer_inputs.quote: Integer-token inputs: out of scope. Never sent. A 400 is fine.

dimensions.quote: `dimensions`: absent or `384`. Any other value is a 400

unknown_fields.note: requester wrote unspecified; either behaviour acceptable; graph-rag sends exactly model and input

status_429_trigger.value: Emit it only if you add an in-function admission limit; otherwise never.
status_429_trigger.quote: Emit it only if you add an in-function admission limit; otherwise never.

max_inputs_expected.quote: Batch size: at most 64 inputs per invoke

input_size_expected.note: characters; upper end of a stated range
input_size_expected.quote: Typical input is one chunk of a few hundred to about 2,000 characters

caller.quote: Same account: yes, and the same region. Principal kind: an IAM role

stages.quote: Stage names in the environment roster: `main` (the dev environment) and `prod` (every other environment).

region.value: us-east-1 (dev, stage main); eu-west-1 (augury-dev, stage prod)
region.quote: First proof target: the **dev** environment — stage `main`, region **us-east-1**, so the function is `aprender-embed-endpoint-main`.
